definitions.explanation: An engine that generates power by burning fuel inside the engine itself, as opposed to external combustion engines like steam engines. Includes gasoline engines, diesel engines, and gas turbines.

examples.japanese: {自動車|じどうしゃ}の{多|おお}くは{内燃機関|ないねんきかん}で{動|うご}く。
examples.english: Most automobiles run on internal combustion engines.

examples.japanese: {電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}の{普及|ふきゅう}で{内燃機関|ないねんきかん}の{時代|じだい}が{終|お}わると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that the era of internal combustion engines will end with the spread of electric vehicles.

examples.japanese: {内燃機関|ないねんきかん}の{効率|こうりつ}を{高|たか}めることで、{燃費|ねんぴ}と{排出|はいしゅつ}ガスの{両方|りょうほう}を{改善|かいぜん}できる。
examples.english: By improving the efficiency of internal combustion engines, both fuel economy and emissions can be improved.

notes:
Composed of {内燃|ないねん} (internal combustion) and {機関|きかん} (engine, mechanism). This technical term is frequently encountered in news about the automotive industry, particularly discussions of the transition from gasoline-powered vehicles to electric vehicles. Japan's automotive industry makes this a particularly relevant topic in Japanese media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内燃機関|ないねんきかん}{車|しゃ}: internal combustion engine vehicle
- {内燃機関|ないねんきかん}の{廃止|はいし}: phasing out of combustion engines
- {内燃機関|ないねんきかん}の{開発|かいはつ}: combustion engine development
- ガソリン{内燃機関|ないねんきかん}: gasoline internal combustion engine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- エンジン: engine — the everyday loanword, used in casual conversation
- {外燃機関|がいねんきかん}: external combustion engine — burns fuel outside the engine (e.g., steam engine)
- {電動|でんどう}モーター: electric motor — the alternative powertrain replacing combustion engines
